author: 2Workly
text: Plex2Shell (CVE-2026-96652 chain) is actively exploited against QNAP NAS Plex instances for unauthenticated RCE. Audit port 32400 exposures, patch to 1.43.3+, and pull management behind a VPN.

author: xer0dayz
text: CVE-2026-61511: critical unauthenticated RCE in vBulletin 5.x/6.x via runMaths eval injection. Nuclei detection template available.

author: CCBalert
text: Multiple critical vulnerabilities in IBM API Connect, including CVE-2026-17402 (CVSS 9.9), allowing authenticated RCE. Other flaws permit unauthenticated administrative takeover. Patch immediately!

author: cveintelligence
text: Critical 9.3 | CVE-2026-124079: rConfig Core – unauthenticated RCE by pushing a crafted serialized job onto the Laravel Horizon queue. Fixed in 8.2.19 (Core) / 8.4.1 (Pro).

author: saltrocklabs
text: An AI agent found exposed API endpoints, logged in with a dev credential left in prod, and pulled records with no rate limit (per WorkOS's write-up). Agents make old sloppiness cheap to exploit, fast.

author: DuckButTurttle
text: Operation Snowball: an AI-agent intrusion into a European telecom exploited Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320. Researchers say it reached a hospital records system on default credentials, but that part is unverified. Source: GBHackers

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: SEGA says Arara Message leaked 2,196,044 newsletter emails; 92,273 also have delivery metadata. Same vendor as the 81.3M ARARA platform leak.

author: hackerstorm
text: CISA adds 3 actively exploited CVEs to the KEV catalog in November 2026: authentication bypass and RCE risks in SonicWall, Apple, and WordPress Core.

author: ksg93rd
text: CVE-2026-58868: critical zero-click RCE in Android's media framework (14-17). Code runs as a file is parsed. Fix: install the Nov 2026 patch.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Weekly CVE Roundup: Linux Kernel unauth root RCE (PoC Live); Alpine SSH root auth bypass (PoC Live); WordPress Core TOCTOU race (CISA KEV); SonicWall SAML/MFA bypass (CISA KEV).

author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical - Keycloak Authorization JS Policy RCE via Stale Session Attribute (CVE-2026-120984).

author: 0xF390
text: Supply chain attack: compromised release of Swarm's official JavaScript SDK @ethersphere/bee-js 13.3.0 detected; installing it triggers malicious payload.

author: cesteban
text: Chainalysis says an external actor using "offensive agentic techniques" got into its systems and internal tools; credentials exposed.

author: nurhayatdev
text: CISA added critical CVE-2026-111497 to KEV: out-of-bounds write in Google's Brotli decoder (1.0.3–1.2.0); update to 1.0.10, 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

author: thecybersecguru
text: SEGA data breach: a supply-chain compromise at Arara, a Japanese bulk email platform, exposed up to 81,329,467 email addresses across ~380 organizations, including 2.19 million SEGA customer addresses.

author: TheCyberSecHub
text: New Supply Chain Attack Compromises Tens of Thousands of GitHub Repositories: Security researchers have detected a malicious workflow affecting tens of thousands of GitHub repositories (Infosecurity Magazine).

author: Stringcoding
text: GitHub officially confirmed a security breach stemming from poisoned Visual Studio Code (VS Code) extensions. Bad actors injected malicious code into widely used developer tools to compromise software supply chains.

author: MonThreat
text: Threat Actor Claims Full Admin Access to Santander Consumer Bank Germany Salesforce Sales Cloud instance, listed on an underground forum (claim, unconfirmed).

author: CCBalert
text: Warning: Actively exploited CVE-2026-114713 (CVSS 8.6) affects #UnrealIRCd. Normal users can execute #IRC commands with server authority. Upgrade to 6.2.7.1 or apply the official hot-patch immediately! https://t.co/AshuAwFS5K #Patch #Patch #Patch

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flags an actively exploited WordPress Core flaw that lets unauthenticated attackers execute code during updates. Experts urge immediate patching and checks for compromise.

author: radware
text: What if attackers use GitHub to target AI coding agents? Radware researchers uncovered a supply chain attack on 61 repos in under an hour. #AISecurity #PromptInjection #SupplyChainSecurity

author: CCBalert
text: Warning: Actively exploited CVE-2026-19868 (CVSS 7.5) affects SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN. Attackers with valid alternate-method credentials may bypass SAML authentication and MFA. Patch immediately!

author: ren0day
text: chatgpt's lockdown mode was supposed to stop prompt injection stealing your chats. check point bypassed it with an html preview, CVE-2025-51591. desktop app needed zero clicks. fixed sept 18. the door was open.

author: qubit0
text: A runaway AI agent just hacked WorkOS — the sign-in provider used by OpenAI & Anthropic. Agents keep escaping test environments. My take: agent escape is now a top-3 threat class. Whose fault: builder, deployer, or platform? Source: #AIAgents #CyberSecurity #InfoSec

author: hifyai
text: An IP that Microsoft tied to an agentic AI campaign was caught exploiting Langflow through CVE-2025-3248 on a VulnCheck decoy. It went for the AI provider and cloud keys Langflow stores, and found a way to decrypt them.

author: likasanma
text: OSV's CVE-2026-123022 record reports command injection in AgentScope's MCP Workspace API, reaching subprocess.Popen through the command argument in _config.py.

Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator CVE-2026-114625: on-prem, any logged-in user, even read-only, can gain operator-level access. Arista says it's actively exploited, and CISA lists it.
